-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.TracedNodeApi` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def node.Step.tracedSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (ml : Loc) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk)
    (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)),
    st.msg.To' = id →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
              isNode n γ N id ∗
                nodeCtx ctx cd ∗
                  sentMsg γ N src st ∗
                    msgPtsC ml (DFrac.own 1) (DFrac.own 1) true
                        { msg := st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := [] } ∗
                      msgCredits γ N st ∗ snapLocalMsg γ id st ∗ trTok γ st -∗
            (▷ ∀ err, nodeErrS n γ N cd err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
              WP
                (((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Step" (intoVal n)))
                    (intoVal (GoInterface.ok ctx)))
                  (intoVal ml))
                {{ Φ }}

def readyGotT (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (rd : Ready)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ce es h L ms ss,
      committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries' st.delivered.length ce ∗
        isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗
          (∃ rs, readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' rs ∗ [∗list] s ∈ rs, readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗
            readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ms ss ∗
              readyLeaderMsgs γ N id st ms ss ∗
                readyEnter n γ N id st (st.afterReady ce es h L ss) ms ∗
                  deliveredLogLb n γ N (st.afterReady ce es h L ss).delivered ∗
                    (⌜phsNext st.hardState h = hsZero⌝ ∨
                        committedAtTerm γ N (phsNext st.hardState h).Term' (phsNext st.hardState h).Commit' ∗
                          ⌜↑(st.afterReady ce es h L ss).delivered.length ≤ uint.Z (phsNext st.hardState h).Commit'⌝) ∗
                      [∗list] q ∈ ms, trTok γ q.st)

theorem trTok_untraced [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (st : MsgSt) (h : γ.trace = none) :
    ⊢ trTok γ st

theorem Cluster.traceSim_persistent (γ : Cluster) (vs : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) :
    Persistent (γ.traceSim vs tn)

theorem Cluster.traceSim_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List
    w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (id : w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (A : GMap w64
    (TraceSim.ServerC × List Etcdraft.Msg)) (Bt : GMap w64 (Bool × Option TraceEv)) (E : CoPset) (hE
    : ↑N ⊆ E) (hA : ∀ (i : w64), i ∈ vs → A !! i = some (TraceSim.toC (TraceSim.confAbs vs)
    ((TraceSim.simInit vs).s (TraceSim.idAbs i)), [])) (hA' : ∀ (i : w64), ¬i ∈ vs → A !! i = none)
    (hBt : ∀ (i : w64), i ∈ vs → Bt !! i = some (false, none)) : ⊢ nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs id ∗
    traceFrag tn.tr [] ∗ ghostMapAuth tn.st 1 A ∗ ghostMapAuth tn.bag 1 ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth tn.bt 1 Bt
    ={E}=∗ γ.traceSim vs tn

def isReadyChan_recvAu.tracedSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n ch : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (Φ : Ready → Bool → IProp GF),
    st.handling = none →
      ⊢
        isReadyChan n γ N ch -∗
          isNode n γ N id -∗
            nodeDriver n γ N st -∗
              ∃ γc,
                isChan ch γc Ready ∗ (£ 1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, readyGotT n γ N id st rd -∗ Φ rd true) -∗ recvAu γc Ready Φ)

theorem Cluster.traceSim_end [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List
    w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (id : w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (L : List TraceEv) (E :
    CoPset) (hE : ↑N ⊆ E) : ⊢ nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs id ∗ γ.traceSim vs tn ∗ traceAuth tn.tr L ={E}=∗
    traceAuth tn.tr L ∗ ⌜∃ σ, TraceSim.SimRun vs L σ ∧ σ.server = TraceSim.confAbs vs ∧
    TraceSim.SimEvents vs.length L⌝

def (sealed) trTok (γ : Cluster) (st : MsgSt) : IProp GF

def (sealed) Cluster.traceSim (γ : Cluster) (vs : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) : IProp GF

def startDone (γ : Cluster) (D : TraceSim.TraceNames → w64 → IProp GF) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  match γ.trace with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some γd => iprop(∃ tn, TraceSim.traceDir γd tn ∗ D tn id)

theorem traceSim_bagRep_nil : TraceSim.BagRep [] []

def startTraceC (γ : Cluster) (vs : List w64) (cv : Config) : IProp GF :=
  match γ.trace with
  | none => iprop(⌜cv.TraceLogger' = GoInterface.nil⌝)
  | some γd =>
    iprop(∃ tn,
        TraceSim.traceDir γd tn ∗
          ⌜(cv.PreVote' = false ∧ cv.CheckQuorum' = false) ∧
                tn.voters = vs ∧ vs.length < 2 ^ 40 ∧ cv.TraceLogger' ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
            isTraceLogger tn.tr cv.TraceLogger' ∗
              γ.traceSim vs tn ∗
                TraceSim.simNode tn cv.ID'
                    (TraceSim.toC (TraceSim.confAbs vs) ((TraceSim.simInit vs).s (TraceSim.idAbs cv.ID'))) [] ∗
                  TraceSim.simBoot tn cv.ID' false none)

def StartNode.tracedSpec (D : TraceSim.TraceNames → w64 → IProp GF) : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (Q : IProp GF) (F : GName → IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        csm.Voters' = [] →
                          csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                            csm.Learners' = [] →
                              csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                  vs = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                    ⊢
                                      ∀ Φ,
                                        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                            typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                              isLogger lok ∗
                                                nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs cv.ID' ∗
                                                  nodeVacant γ cv.ID' ∗
                                                    AU <{ ∃∃ S, raftState γ cv.ID' S ∗ ⌜S = RaftState.init⌝ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅
                                                          <{ raftState γ cv.ID' S, COMM Q }> ∗
                                                      restartStorage γ (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                          { hs := hsZero, snap := none,
                                                            base := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, ents := [] }
                                                          csm 0 F ∗
                                                        ownSlice peers pv dq ∗ peersCtx pv ctxs ∗ startTraceC γ vs cv -∗
                                          (▷
                                              ∀ nd,
                                                (∃ n K,
                                                    ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                      nodeStartedFresh n γ N vs ctxs cv.ID' ∗
                                                        isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                          nodeDriver n γ N (NodeDriverState.init (GoInterface.ok si) K) ∗
                                                            nodeConfig n γ N
                                                                { applied := 0,
                                                                  membership := Membership.simple (listToSet vs) } ∗
                                                              nodeRunning n γ N 1 ∗
                                                                Q ∗ F K ∗ ownSlice peers pv dq ∗ startDone γ D cv.ID') -∗
                                                  Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                            WP (((intoVal (functions StartNode [])) (intoVal c)) (intoVal peers)) {{ Φ }}
